name: AI Product Content Creator For WooCommerce
author: StorePro

sections.description:
Introducing the AI Product Content Creator For WooCommerce, a powerful plugin designed to boost your sales and conversion rates by generating SEO-optimized product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation descriptions that will be more attractive to your users. Powered by the advanced AI of ChatGPT, this plugin allows you to effortlessly create compelling product descriptions tailored to your WooCommerce products.

Simply input your keywords, and the AI product content creator will generate unique, high-quality product titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation descriptions that enhance your store’s SEO, making your products more discoverable. The plugin’s smart algorithms ensure that every description is optimized for search engines based on the keywords you provide, helping your products rank higher and attract more customers.

Whether you’re looking for an AI WooCommerce product description writer or a tool to streamline your content creation process, this plugin is the perfect solution for generating professional, keyword-optimized content with ease.

The AI Product Content Creator For WooCommerce plugin uses AI to create compelling SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation descriptions to help improve your sales and conversion rates.

Features:

  • Automatically generate SEO-friendly titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation descriptions based on your keywords.
  • You can modify any existing titles, descriptions, short descriptions, and variation descriptions using their current content as a prompt.
  • Tailor content for higher sales and conversion rates.
  • Re-write your existing descriptions and experiment with improved descriptions and titles.
  • Powered by AI and ChatGPT for high-quality content creation.
  • Seamlessly integrates with WooCommerce to enhance your store’s product visibility.
  • Bulk Content Creation: Generate content for multiple products at once. Select multiple products from the WooCommerce product listing page and generate content (titles, descriptions, short descriptions) for them in bulk.
  • Easy content generation for selected fields: Define which fields to generate (e.g., title, description, short description) for each selected product.

Unlock the full potential of your WooCommerce store with this powerful AI WooCommerce product description tool!

Coming Soon

Support for Multiple AI Models
Currently, the plugin supports OpenAI for content generation. Future updates will introduce the ability to select from multiple AI models for generating content.

A/B Description Testing
Test a new version of your description and see if it improves your sales. If not, revert to your previous description.

Geographical Audience Targeting
Target your description to a particular audience using language and wording that appeals to your target audience.

Lots more features are on their way!

Disclaimer

AI Product Content Creator For WooCommerce is a plugin that relies on the OpenAI API to generate content for WooCommerce products. When you use this plugin, requests are sent to the OpenAI API for processing. You need your own API keys and must follow the rules set by the AI service you choose. For OpenAI, check their Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. It is also important to check your usage on the OpenAI website for accurate information. Please do so with other services as well.
The developer of AI Product Content Creator For WooCommerce and related parties are not responsible for any issues or losses caused by using the plugin or AI-generated content. You should talk to a legal expert and follow the laws and regulations of your country. AI Product Content Creator for WooCommerce only stores data on your own server, and it is your responsibility to keep it safe.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-product-content-creator-for-woocommerce folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure settings under ‘AI Content Creator’ in the admin dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

You can generate product content by navigating to the product edit page.

Where can I get support?

Support is available through the plugin support page.

Is the plugin free?

Yes, the plugin is free to use. But you must use your own API key.

Do I need an API Key?

Yes, you will need to use your own OpenAI API. This is simple to create. You can follow the instructions on the OpenAI website. However, the basic steps are as follows:

  1. Log in or sign up to the OpenAI platform.
  2. Go to the API Keys page.
  3. Click Create new secret key.
  4. Name your API key.
  5. Copy your key to your clipboard.
  6. Paste the key in the plugin settings.

Does the Plugin only work on WooCommerce Products?

Yes, we focus on eCommerce and this plugin focuses on improving your products for better sales and conversions.
sections.changelog:
1.2.1

  • Display API errors on frontend during bulk content generation.
  • Removed hiding of the prompt field from the “content to generate” field, allowing regeneration of the same field content using previous content as a prompt.
  • Added console log and debug log enable/disable options in settings.

1.2.0

  • Introduced Bulk Content Creation on the WooCommerce product listing page.
  • Select multiple products and click “Generate Contents Using AI” to create content.
  • Choose specific fields as prompts and define which fields to generate (title, description, short description).
  • Automatically saves the generated content for the selected products.
  • Enhanced content generation for higher efficiency in product content creation.

1.1.0

  • Fixed issues with adding new products.
  • Added feature to generate new title, description, and short description from existing content.
  • Rewrote existing product variation’s description.
  • Tested with WordPress 6.7 and WooCommerce 9.4.1.
  • Verified compatibility with PHP 8.3.11.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
